input.goal: Search the web for the date of the Dublin Marathon in 2026 (this year, current date is October 2026). Report the exact date and whether it has already happened, and the source.

content.text: [happy] The Dublin Marathon is on Sunday 25 October 2026, with the start at 8:45. That's six days from now, so if you're running it, it's time to stop reading about it and start tapering.
